name: Aunt Nelly's Pudding
author: Isabella Beeton (1861)

source.name: Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management

ingredients.item: the rind and juice of 1 lemon
a few strips of candied lemon-peel

steps: Chop the suet finely; mix with it the flour, treacle, lemon-peel minced, and candied lemon-peel; add the cream, lemon-juice, and 2 well-beaten eggs; beat the pudding well, put it into a buttered basin, tie it down with a cloth, and boil from 3-1/2 to 4 hours.

culture.text: From Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management (1861) by Isabella Beeton. It was a Victorian best-seller that shaped how British households cooked and ran their kitchens for generations, and it was one of the first cookbooks to list ingredients before the method.
